🎥🎬: Ebenezer (2026)

Ebenezer Scrooge is a wealthy businessman whose obsession with money has left him bitter, isolated, and hostile toward the Christmas spirit. But when the ghost of his former business partner, Jacob Marley, appears, Scrooge is warned that his life is heading toward a terrible fate unless he changes his ways.

Haunted by supernatural encounters, Scrooge is forced to confront the choices that shaped his past, the people he has hurt, and the future awaiting him. As the spirits reveal truths he can no longer ignore, he must face his darkest regrets and fight for a second chance at redemption in this haunting reimagining of Charles Dickens’ classic, starring Johnny Depp, Ian McKellen, and Rupert Grint.

In theaters November 13th. Tickets on sale now!

source_details.synopsis: Ebenezer (also known as Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol) is an upcoming dark fantasy comedy-drama film directed by Ti West from a screenplay by Nathaniel Halpern, based on the 1843 novella A Christmas Carol by Charles Dickens. The film stars Johnny Depp as Ebenezer Scrooge, alongside Rupert Grint, Andrea Riseborough, Sam Claflin, Daisy Ridley, Arthur Conti, Ellie Bamber, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Charlie Murphy, Tramell Tillman, and Ian McKellen. Ebenezer is scheduled to be released in the United Kingdom and United States by Paramount Pictures on November 13, 2026.
